ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, and the three points A, B, and C are on the circle, with B above the circle, A at the lower left, and C at the lower right; triangle ABC is inscribed in the circle. Point O is marked inside the circle and serves as the center of the circle, segments OA, OB, and OC are drawn, the central angle ∠AOB is marked as 140°, and the central angle ∠BOC is marked as 120°. Then reason: One full turn around the center O is 360°. Given ∠AOB = 140° and ∠BOC = 120°, the remaining central angle ∠AOC = 360° - 140° - 120° = 100°. What is required is ∠ABC, which is an inscribed angle intercepting the same arc AC, and the corresponding central angle is ∠AOC = 100°. According to the inscribed angle theorem, an inscribed angle is equal to half of the central angle it subtends, therefore ∠ABC = 100° ÷ 2 = 50°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a triangle ABC inscribed in a circle with O at the center and radii OA, OB, OC drawn; A and C are the two lower points and B is at the top. From the text, use the given central angles ∠AOB = 140° and ∠BOC = 120°. Since the full angle around O is 360°, compute the remaining central angle ∠AOC = 360° - 140° - 120° = 100°. The angle asked for, ∠ABC, is an inscribed angle intercepting arc AC not containing B, whose central angle is ∠AOC. By the inscribed angle theorem, ∠ABC = 1/2 · 100° = 50°.

再推理：圆心 O 周围一周是 360°。已知 ∠AOB = 140°，∠BOC = 120°，所以剩余的中心角 ∠AOC = 360° - 140° - 120° = 100°。要求的是 ∠ABC，它是截同一弧 AC 的圆周角，而对应的中心角是 ∠AOC = 100°。根据圆周角定理，圆周角等于所对中心角的一半，因此 ∠ABC = 100° ÷ 2 = 50°。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as showing radii OA, OB, and OC drawn from the center O to the circle, with ray BO lying inside angle ABC and splitting it into ∠ABO and ∠OBC. From the text, O is the center, so OA = OB = OC. In isosceles triangle AOB, the vertex angle at O is 140°, so each base angle is (180° - 140°)/2 = 20°; hence ∠ABO = 20°. In isosceles triangle BOC, the vertex angle at O is 120°, so each base angle is (180° - 120°)/2 = 30°; hence ∠OBC = 30°. Therefore ∠ABC = ∠ABO + ∠OBC = 20° + 30° = 50°.
